minimumReleaseAge: 0
# One schema decides which modules an instance may parameterize; every package that reads it reads 0.1.1, which
# admits all six house scopes and no dot segments (Cold Red Gate names a @coesite-operations record).
overrides:
  "@red-cup-engineering/computer-content-engineering-services-section": 0.1.1
  # One driver: MetroPlat is the library FeltOS loads, so it must import the driver's FeltOS. MetroPlat 0.9.8 pins
  # FeltOS 0.21.1 exactly; its own copy kept the work clock's operations where the driver's heartbeat never looked
  # ("no clock operations were assembled for this data root"). MetroPlat 0.9.9 makes FeltOS its peer; 0.9.11 pins
  # the peer it was received with, so this is that one.
  "@red-cup-engineering/feltos": 0.21.9-dev.0
  # Preserve generation 115's complete actor-result custody and hydration at both actual RPC consumers.
  "@red-cup-engineering/feltos>@red-cup-engineering/computer-system-engine": 0.1.15
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.10.1>@red-cup-engineering/computer-system-engine": 0.1.15
  # Receipt recovery binds the actual FeltOS actor and Metro wire consumer to the qualified suppliers.
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.10.2>@red-cup-engineering/computer-system-engine": 0.1.15
  "@red-cup-engineering/feltos@0.21.9-dev.0>@red-cup-engineering/activitypub-services-section": 0.10.0
  "@red-cup-engineering/computer-system-engine@0.1.15>@red-cup-engineering/activitypub-services-section": 0.10.0
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.10.2>@red-cup-engineering/activitypub-services-section": 0.10.0
  # The human closure is an account authority boundary, so every consumer uses
  # the guarded client; no older nested Kalshi copy can escape it.
  "@red-cup-engineering/kalshi-services-section": 0.1.48
  # Sealed log days (BGZF segments) read as absent to an older reader, so one SEAVT log implementation serves every
  # reader and writer in the runtime; 0.1.5 reads every day 0.1.2 wrote, adds seal-seavt-logs --type, and imports semantic identity from its owner;
  # 0.1.6 repairs the identical direct head writer of the arrival and factory evidence (live since generation 104).
  "@red-cup-engineering/semiotic-eavt-services-section": 0.3.1
  # Distinct historical contract laws coexist. Only these source-qualified callers migrate:
  # modern typed Work/World/pricing readers and intermediate callers of unchanged APIs.
  # Strict Organizing 0.2.3 callers and unrelated historic implementations remain selected.
  "@red-cup-engineering/feltos@0.21.8>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/feltos@0.21.9-dev.0>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/computer-system-engine@0.1.15>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.10.2>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.9.3>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.9.11>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/metroplat@0.10.1>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/computer-inference-engine@0.1.21>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
  "@red-cup-engineering/computer-inference-engine@0.1.22>@red-cup-engineering/organizing": 0.7.2
